fields.description:
# RF-12b: Ban Button — Confirm Reason/Notes Capture

### IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

* A Ban button on the Referrer record (Account, Referrer record type) opens a screen flow that captures a Ban Reason, Ban Notes, and an optional "Flag related Player record" checkbox.
* Ban Reason is a required single-select field.
* Ban Notes is a required free-text field.
* On submission, the flow sets Referrer Status = Banned on the record.
* On submission, the flow moves all unpaid payouts (Status = New or Logged) on this Referrer to Hold. Payouts already at Paid are not affected.
* If "Flag related Player record" is checked, the flow sets the related Player's Review Required and Review Reason fields (see BUILD-177).
* Full automation detail (payout-Hold logic, Flag Player behavior) is built and tracked in [BUILD-196 — Referrer: Ban Automation](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217693254043092/f/) — this ticket documents the confirmed Ban Reason values and the decision to build the button.

### FIELDS

* Ban Reason — Radio button (single-select), required. Values: Under Investigation, Confirmed Fraud, Network Policy Violation, Associated with Banned Network, Other.
* Ban Notes — Text (long text recommended), required.

### NOTES

* Provenance: raised in the Aug 24 Kobi/Taryn Weekly Planning sync; confirmed in the Aug 25 Wagertech <> Jumpr Weekly Sync.
* Related: [BUILD-196 — Referrer: Ban Automation](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217693254043092/f/) (Referrer: Ban Automation — full triggered-action spec), [BUILD-175 — Player: Ban Status + Banner](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217686087320935/f/) (Player precedent, banner-only, no button).
* 2026-08-26: found that the prototype's Ban Reason list (in BUILD-196) did not match this ticket's Weekly-Sync-confirmed list. Taryn confirmed this ticket's list is the one to build against; BUILD-196 was corrected to match.

### SOURCE

* Aug 24 Kobi/Taryn Weekly Planning — [transcript](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qB7cUeJGFs_SZba9NX5R9MWKzOj8yTetmWTWoqY3gw8/edit), verified.
* Aug 25 Wagertech <> Jumpr Weekly Sync — not recorded or accessible via the connected Fathom account; sourced from a transcript Taryn pasted directly into chat.
* Dependencies: [BUILD-196 — Referrer: Ban Automation](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217693254043092/f/), [BUILD-175 — Player: Ban Status + Banner](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217686087320935/f/)
* Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
* Created 2026-08-24 from the Aug 24 Kobi/Taryn Weekly Planning sync. Updated 2026-08-26 with confirmation from the Aug 25 Weekly Sync; IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS restructured to an absolute spec same day; reconciled against BUILD-196 same day.

08/25 Weekly Sync: The Ban button and captured reason/notes are still wanted.

Ban Reason list for Referrer — Under Investigation, Confirmed Fraud, Network Policy Violation, Other — approved it as the starting list.

One addition: Lina asked for a reason covering a Referrer banned because they're linked to another banned account or network, since that's one of the more common real-world cases. Call it 'Associated with Banned Network'. We will start with a fuller list now, trim it later once real usage shows what's actually being used.

Ban button and flow have been implemented

Outstanding: No automation associated with this button yet in the flow.
